claims.claim: Added a dedicated versioned REPAIR policy, fail-closed Issue parser, GitHub-hosted admission workflow, fixed self-hosted target, and bounded local repair-wakeup command. Coding actions require one supported Executor; NO_CHANGE forbids coding-Executor authority.

Added a separate durable REPAIR dispatch journal with immutable selector collision detection, at-most-once delivery, exact admission-time RUN binding, terminal replay, and fail-closed reconciliation for active, unbound, or uncertain deliveries.

Carrier acceptance now requires successful admission and fixed-workflow completion. Rejected, failed, cancelled, or skipped delivery cannot close the Issue successfully or claim RUN, verification, review, or publication success; identical intent remains usable through manual or local bounded carriers.

The implementation delegates into existing run_repair authority and uses separate REPAIR workflows, commands, locks, and state without widening PRIMARY, REMEDIATION, verification, review, or publication authority.

Added focused parser, workflow, dispatch/restart, NO_CHANGE, collision, and operator regression coverage. All modified files are within TASK-111 revision-2 scope, the implementation is committed, and the worktree is clean.
